name: Mymoorapelta
isnote: Called a nodosaurid in the cited revision, but polacanthid placement is disputed; placed in Ankylosauria.
sum: Mymoorapelta is a small Late Jurassic armoured dinosaur from the Mygatt-Moore Quarry of Colorado, with five armour types including a sacral shield.
wsnote: Estimated length of the largest specimen (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: The holotype from the Mygatt-Moore Quarry, with osteoderms, a partial skull, vertebrae and other bones — Morrison Formation, Colorado.
material: Few specimens are known; more than 160 bones have been collected at the quarry.
biology: Armoured herbivore with a narrow, almost triangular skull and large horns pointing backwards from the brow.
author: Kirkland and Carpenter 1994
